IMD issues orange alert for Himachal Pradesh; heavy rain forecast across Delhi, Uttarakhand, Rajasthan
The IMD has issued an orange alert for Himachal Pradesh, forecasting heavy to very heavy rain on Monday and Tuesday. Delhi, Uttarakhand, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh and several other states are also likely to receive heavy rain, while thunderstorms and lightning are expected across multiple regions. Monsoon activity is expected to remain strong through August 13-15.
The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued an orange alert for Himachal Pradesh as heavy to very heavy rainfall is expected in parts of the state on Monday. Several other parts of the country are also likely to experience heavy rain, thunderstorms and lightning.
The IMD has forecast heavy to very heavy rainfall at isolated places over Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand, east Rajasthan and west Madhya Pradesh.
Heavy rain is also likely over Assam, Meghalaya, Chhattisgarh, east Madhya Pradesh, Jammu and Kashmir, Ladakh, Gilgit-Baltistan, Muzaffarabad, Jharkhand and Uttar Pradesh, as per TOI.
Delhi-NCR weather
Delhi, Haryana and Chandigarh may receive heavy rain at isolated places on Monday, with thunderstorms and lightning also likely. The weather department has forecast continued monsoon activity across the region as rainfall remains active over several parts of north India.
Himachal Pradesh and Uttarakhand are expected to remain wet, with heavy to very heavy rainfall possible in parts of both states.
The Shimla Meteorological Centre has issued an orange alert for heavy to very heavy rain in Himachal Pradesh on Monday and Tuesday. The state is expected to continue receiving rainfall through August 14.
Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh and UP
East Rajasthan is likely to receive heavy to very heavy rain on Monday, with very heavy rainfall possible in parts of the state during August 10 and 11.
West Madhya Pradesh is also under a heavy to very heavy rainfall warning, while east Madhya Pradesh and Chhattisgarh may receive heavy rain.
Uttar Pradesh is likely to see heavy rain at isolated places, while thunderstorms and lightning are possible over parts of Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh and Rajasthan, TOI reported.
Rain forecast for Bihar, Jharkhand, Odisha
Jharkhand may receive heavy rain on Monday, while Bihar and Odisha are likely to see thunderstorms accompanied by lightning and gusty winds. Rainfall activity is expected to remain widespread over Jharkhand and Odisha over the coming days.
Northeast remains under rain watch
Assam and Meghalaya are likely to receive heavy rain along with thunderstorms and lightning. As per TOI, Nagaland, Manipur, Mizoram and Tripura may also experience rain and thunderstorms, with heavy rainfall expected over parts of the Northeast in the coming days.
West and south India
Konkan and Goa are likely to continue receiving widespread rainfall, while Gujarat, central Maharashtra, Marathwada and Saurashtra and Kutch may see scattered rain.
Thunderstorms and lightning are also likely over parts of Gujarat, central Maharashtra and Marathwada.
In south India, widespread rainfall is expected over coastal Karnataka, Kerala, Mahe and Lakshadweep. Heavy rain is possible in parts of these regions as well as south interior Karnataka.
Parts of Andhra Pradesh, Rayalaseema, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, Karaikal and Telangana may also receive rain, with thunderstorms and gusty winds likely in some areas.
Monsoon to remain active
The southwest monsoon is expected to remain active across several parts of the country, with rainfall continuing over north, central, eastern, northeastern, western and southern regions.
The IMD expects rainfall activity to remain active through August 13-15, with heavy rain likely over parts of the hills, central India, the Northeast, Jharkhand, Odisha and the west coast.
Very heavy rainfall may persist in parts of Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh and the Northeast, TOI reported.
